title: Unused Layout
description: Unused-code rule — layouts no script ever navigates to. Review: layouts opened only by name or manually can appear here.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unreferenced layouts still load themes and objects and slow the solution.
rule.remediation: Confirm the layout is not opened by name / manually, then delete it.
